tools.name: get_solar_generation
tools.description: Retrieve Belgian national measured/upscaled PV generation in MW, never forecasts. Offset-aware start/end, max 24h; solar from 26 October 2026.

start.description: Inclusive interval start, ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset (for example 2026-11-17T10:00:00Z). Must align to a UTC quarter-hour; start < end; maximum 24 elapsed hours.
start.title: Start

end.description: Exclusive interval end, ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset. UTC quarter-hour aligned, after start and no more than 24 elapsed hours later. Split longer ranges, including 25-hour Belgian DST days.
end.title: End

unit.description: Unit of the source measurements. For analytics this remains the input unit; energy_mwh is explicitly MWh.
unit.title: Unit

values.description: Normalized measurements as numbers; null means unavailable, never zero. Units and interval duration are in metadata.
values.title: Values

tools.name: get_wind_generation
tools.description: Retrieve Belgian measured/upscaled wind MW: total, onshore or offshore. Offset-aware start/end, max 24h; missing components yield null totals.

start.description: Inclusive interval start, ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset (for example 2026-11-17T10:00:00Z). Must align to a UTC quarter-hour; start < end; maximum 24 elapsed hours.
start.title: Start

end.description: Exclusive interval end, ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset. UTC quarter-hour aligned, after start and no more than 24 elapsed hours later. Split longer ranges, including 25-hour Belgian DST days.
end.title: End

wind_type.description: total (default): Belgian onshore plus offshore; onshore: four regional/grid components; offshore: federal offshore component. Applies only to wind; leave total for other series. Incomplete component sets yield null, not partial totals.
wind_type.title: Wind Type

unit.description: Unit of the source measurements. For analytics this remains the input unit; energy_mwh is explicitly MWh.
unit.title: Unit

values.description: Normalized measurements as numbers; null means unavailable, never zero. Units and interval duration are in metadata.
values.title: Values

tools.name: calculate_energy
tools.description: Calculate solar/wind generation energy or total-load energy in MWh by fetching its own power source and summing MW times 0.25h. Use for energy, rather than power in MW. Offset-aware start/end, max 24h; coverage reported, no gap filling. No raw-record input.

series.description: Source to fetch and integrate: solar PV generation, wind generation or Belgian total load. Fetches data itself; do not resend records. Not suitable for instantaneous imbalance or prices.
series.title: Series

start.description: Inclusive interval start, ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset (for example 2026-11-17T10:00:00Z). Must align to a UTC quarter-hour; start < end; maximum 24 elapsed hours.

end.title: End

wind_type.description: total (default): Belgian onshore plus offshore; onshore: four regional/grid components; offshore: federal offshore component. Applies only to wind; leave total for other series. Incomplete component sets yield null, not partial totals.
wind_type.title: Wind Type

energy_mwh.description: Observed energy in MWh over available intervals; null if no usable power values. No gap filling or full-period estimate.
energy_mwh.title: Energy Mwh

covered_hours.description: Elapsed hours with usable quarter-hour power measurements.
covered_hours.title: Covered Hours

method.default: Sum non-null interval-average MW times fixed interval hours; no gap filling.
method.title: Method

unit.description: Unit of the source measurements. For analytics this remains the input unit; energy_mwh is explicitly MWh.
unit.title: Unit

tools.name: check_data_quality
